prompt: Rendered in the style of a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene depicts a bustling construction site. On the far left stands a tall crane with a yellow cab, its hook dangling loosely above a stack of gray bricks. Next to the bricks sits a worker in a blue helmet, tying his bootlaces while looking at a clipboard held by a supervisor in a white hard hat standing nearby. The supervisor points at the paper, engaging in a discussion with the seated worker. In the center foreground, a cement mixer with a rotating drum dominates the view, surrounded by wet puddles reflecting the sky. Leaning against the mixer is a shovel with a wooden handle, positioned next to a wheelbarrow filled with sand. A foreman in an orange vest stands beside the wheelbarrow, gesturing toward a pile of rebar on the right side of the frame. Near the rebar, two laborers in green vests lift a heavy steel beam together, their muscles tensed in effort. Behind them, a bulldozer with large treads rests idle, its blade lowered to the ground. Perched on the bulldozer’s seat is a stray cat with black and white fur, watching the activity with keen interest. To the right of the bulldozer, a surveyor in a plaid shirt adjusts a tripod-mounted level, peering through the lens intently. An assistant in a beige jacket holds a measuring rod steady for the surveyor, standing just behind the tripod. In the background, a partially built wall of red bricks rises, with scaffolding made of metal poles clinging to its side. A ladder leans against the scaffolding, leading up to a platform where a mason in a dusty apron applies mortar with a trowel. Below the platform, a bucket of water sits on the dirt, next to a coiled hose. A security guard in a dark uniform stands near the site entrance on the far right, holding a radio to his ear. Beside him, a delivery truck with an open back door waits, its engine off. A driver in a cap leans out of the truck window, handing a package to the security guard. There is no heavy rain falling on the scene. There is no digital billboard displaying advertisements. There is no flock of birds flying overhead.
